== Original image and preservation verification (Stories 386, 382) ==

The published Players Committee asset is a PNG at a source URL ending in .gif. Its unchanged bytes were uploaded using a .png filename. The public wiki original was downloaded after upload and checked against the source and archived payload: 399005 bytes, SHA-256 <code>1253dc294afc44bcacde28a8f21149a6fcd837959d6292ed6c8fed382a440590</code>. The File page labels the exact-byte source-host archive separately and preserves the printed image credit. Its source-host content mapping is being reported to the existing image-preservation Story.
